narrative.overview: A static product page extending NextUp's Android Cobalt identity. This sidecar applies only to website/; website/DESIGN.md describes the web system and styles.css supplies its implemented tokens. Root Android design files remain authoritative for native UI.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained borders and a single notification shadow

rules.name: Scoped web identity
rules.body: Apply these values only to website/. Preserve the separate native Android system.

rules.name: Purposeful depth
rules.body: The notification is lifted from its pale stage with the sole soft shadow; explanatory sections use dividers.

dos: Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain wrapping copy and a single-column layout at 780px and below.
Do keep the default sample and informational content usable without JavaScript.
donts: Don't use stock photos, personal screenshots, decorative gradients, or fabricated endorsements.
Don't treat the illustrative notification as a raster mockup.
